topic: Advanced Python: Iterators, Generators, and Decorators
learningObjectives: Explain how iterators and generators control data iteration.
Use generator functions to process values lazily.
Understand how decorators modify or extend function behavior.

activities.title: Iteration Map
activities.instruction: Trace how Python moves through iterable data.

content.concept: Iterators provide values one at a time through the iteration protocol.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Generator Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore how yield creates a generator.

content.concept: Generators produce values lazily using yield, avoiding the need to store all results at once.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Lazy Evaluation Lab
activities.instruction: Adjust the data flow and observe evaluation.

content.concept: Lazy evaluation computes values only when they are requested, which can reduce memory usage.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Decorator Builder
activities.instruction: Build a decorator around a function.

content.concept: Decorators wrap functions to add or modify behavior without changing the original function definition.
